title: Crossroads Baker Base Surge.jpg
author: Anonymous military photographer
credit: W.A.Schurcliff, Historian, Joint Task Force One,Bombs at Bikini: the Official Report of Operation Crossroads, 1947, plate 28.
description: The Baker shot of Operation Crossroads, Bikini Atoll, July 25, 1946. As the spray column collapses a 900-foot-tall "base surge" of radioactive mist envelops the target ships. Ship in the foreground (left) is the Japanese battleship Nagato.
